note: cvars emitted into speedrun.cfg. sv_cheats stays 0: no run with cheats enabled is valid.

cvars.name: sr_timer_enable
cvars.desc: Master switch for the authoritative RTA run timer.

cvars.name: sr_timer_hud
cvars.desc: Draw the timer, current split and PB delta on the HUD.

cvars.name: sr_timer_hud_pos
cvars.desc: Normalised screen position of the timer HUD.

cvars.name: sr_splits_announce
cvars.desc: Print split time and PB delta to the console on level change.

cvars.name: sr_pb_path
cvars.desc: Personal-best file, one 'map=ms' line per split.

cvars.name: sr_autodemo
cvars.desc: Record a demo for every run (ported from BugfixedHL auto demo).

cvars.name: sr_practice_mode
cvars.desc: Practice mode never writes a PB and marks the run as invalid.

cvars.name: sv_cheats
cvars.desc: MUST stay 0. Any run recorded with cheats on is rejected.
